AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Perfect is a study app with questions and their correct answers, flashcards, lessons, ebooks, FAQs and news. Most content is in Arabic and is only available after the user unlocks it with a coupon. Operational Patterns: - 'searchContent' returns answer text for a question; 'openContent' opens a result from it using its link. - Pass the user's question or its key words as the query, in the language of the content. Constraints: - Only unlocked content is searched. When 'searchContent' returns matched=false, Perfect has no answer for the query. - 'openContent' accepts only links returned by 'searchContent'.
